1527153.steps:
1. From the 'Address Objects' page, click on the 'IPv6 only' radio button. 2. Click on the 'Purge All' button

In SonicOS 6.1.3.0 version, there are no 'IPv6 only' , 'IPv4 only', 'IPv4 and IPv6 '  radio buttons

1527158.steps:

4. Click on 'Add' under the Address Object column.

1527171.steps:
1. From 'System -> Settings', click on 'Export Settings' and save the file locally.
2. Set the firewall to factory defaults.
3. After the firewall comes up, go to 'System -> Settings' and load the previously saved settings.
1527171.initial:
IPv6 address objects of the following type created
 -1. test1 - Type Host, Zone - LAN
 -2. test2 - Type Range, Zone - LAN
Both test1 and test2 combined into a custom address object 'test' (as in Test case 28)
1527171.title: Export prefs, set to factory defaults and import the prefs and verify the address objects and address groups are still present
1527171.result: Verify that the address objects 'test1', 'test2' and the address group 'test' are still present on the firewall.

""X1:V164 IPv6 Link-Local Address"",
""X1:V164 IPv6 Primary Dynamic Address"",
